title: SS27 Girls' Knit Shape and Fit Outlook
summary: Girls' knit shapes: oversized tees, bike shorts, jersey dresses, terry sets, swimsuits and two-pieces.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fatamadrina lists relaxed shapes, dungarees, oversized T-shirts, pleated dresses and lightweight jackets as SS27 silhouettes<sup>[1]</sup>
- Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" swimwear runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy, in technical fabrics including sustainable lycra, with UV protection<sup>[2]</sup>
- MilK's Dressing Idéal chose matching sets by Catimini and Semon ApartMent, a terry top by Piupiuchick, pyjamas by Oda London, a sailor top by Loir Paris, and shoes by Tnin and Affenzahn<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes and fit
sections.body:
- **Oversized tee and bike short.**
- **Jersey T-shirt dress.**
- **Terry top and shorts.**
- **Swimsuit and two-piece.**
- **Rib tank.**

design_implications:
- Age-appropriate swim cuts.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
